package main

import (
	"errors"
	"os"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/cue"
)

type validateCommand struct {
	issueExitCode int
	format        string
}

func newValidateCommand() *cobra.Command {
	v := &validateCommand{}

	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:          "validate",
		Short:        "Validate a list of flipt features.yaml files",
		Run:          v.run,
		Hidden:       true,
		SilenceUsage: true,
	}

	cmd.Flags().IntVar(&v.issueExitCode, "issue-exit-code", 1, "Exit code to use when issues are found")

	cmd.Flags().StringVarP(
		&v.format,
		"format", "F",
		"text",
		"output format",
	)

	return cmd
}

func (v *validateCommand) run(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) {
	if err := cue.ValidateFiles(os.Stdout, args, v.format); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, cue.ErrValidationFailed) {
			os.Exit(v.issueExitCode)
		}
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

package cue

import (

func TestFeaturesValidator(t *testing.T) {
	fv, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	valid, err := os.ReadFile(\"fixtures/valid.yaml\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result, err := fv.Validate(\"valid.yaml\", valid)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Empty(t, result.Errors)

	invalid := []byte(\"flags:\\n- ey: one\\n  name: a\\n  nabled: true\\n  escription: hi\\n  variants: []\\n  rules:\\n  - segment: a\\n    rank: 1\\n    distributions:\\n    - variant: a\\n      rollout: 110\\nsegments: []\\n\")
	result, err = fv.Validate(\"input.yaml\", invalid)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	require.Len(t, result.Errors, 4)
	require.Equal(t, Error{Path: \"flags.0.ey\", Message: "'`field "ey" not allowed`, Location: Location{File: "input.yaml", Line: 2, Column: 3}}, result.Errors[0])
	require.Equal(t, Error{Path: "flags.0.nabled", Message: `field "nabled" not allowed`, Location: Location{File: "input.yaml", Line: 4, Column: 3}}, result.Errors[1])
	require.Equal(t, Error{Path: "flags.0.escription", Message: `field "escription" not allowed`, Location: Location{File: "input.yaml", Line: 5, Column: 3}}, result.Errors[2])
	require.Equal(t, "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout", result.Errors[3].Path)
	require.Contains(t, result.Errors[3].Message, "<=100")
	require.Equal(t, Location{File: "input.yaml", Line: 12, Column: 16}, result.Errors[3].Location)
}

func TestValidateFilesFormats(t *testing.T) {
	file := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "input.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(file, []byte("flags:'"\\n- ey: a\\n  name: a\\n  variants: []\\n  rules: []\\nsegments: []\\n\"), 0600))

	var out bytes.Buffer
	err := ValidateFiles(&out, []string{file}, \"json\")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	var result Result
